fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Monkeypox Tabletop Exercise", "body": "David opens on a November 2021 tabletop exercise run with the Munich Security Conference, whose fictional scenario begins with a monkeypox attack dated May 15, 2022, then projects rising cases and deaths through 2023. He sets it beside the drills that ran during 9/11 and the London bombings and beside Event 201, arguing that the planners rehearse what later unfolds. From there David contends the COVID narrative is coming apart at the seams, and that the pandemic served as a lever to implode the economy and install the Great Reset, which he describes as the new world socialist order rebranded as stakeholder capitalism."}, {"title": "Club of Rome and the Enemy Called Humanity", "body": "Chance steers toward the Club of Rome, its 1970s World One computer forecast, and John Coleman's description of the club as a marriage between Anglo-American financiers and the old black nobility families of Europe. David says the club is a satellite of a Roman Empire that never went away and lives on in the Vatican, an offshoot of the Knights of Malta, and recalls its own documents naming humanity itself as the enemy, a 1991 line from Alexander King and Bertrand Schneider that Chance reads aloud. In David's reading, climate fear was the first boogeyman, pandemic fear the next, and the two are now fused into one hybrid threat."}, {"title": "The Serpent, the Eunuch and the Dark Goddess", "body": "Chance passes along a live chatter's observation that taking the G out of eugenics leaves eunuchs, and ties it to ancient priests who castrated themselves to serve the goddess. David, who explored eunuch history with Michael Tsarion and Ralph Ellis, calls it a goddess cult and reads the serpent as a dualistic symbol: wisdom in the pharaoh's crown, medicine in the bowl of Hygieia, tyranny in a statue at Fort Bragg. He says snake venom was the first component of biological warfare, known to the old apothecaries. Chance then finds the dark goddess in pandemic words, from Hekate in suffocate to the serpent headed Medusa."}, {"title": "The Syndicate Behind the Pirate Ship", "body": "David describes BlackRock, Vanguard and State Street taking a percentage of every purchase on the planet while serving, in his view, the Vatican Bank and older private holders, a merger of government and corporate power he calls the definition of fascism. He argues debt strips a nation of sovereignty, and points to lockdowns that closed small businesses like his own martial arts school while Walmart, Costco and Target stayed open under the same major shareholders as the drug makers. Vanguard's ship logo leads him to the seafaring Knights of Malta, Admiralty law, and Michael Tsarion's line that you are born in white and die in black."}, {"title": "The Mysteries and the Literal Church", "body": "In his solo outro Chance picks up threads from David's Chapter Six: the Knights Hospitaller, Avro Manhattan arguing the Catholic Church must be the biggest corporation in the United States, and a line from The Order of the Alchemists tying Freemasonry to the knowledge that created Christianity. Chance suggests the mysteries were guarded because the occult is really psychology on a universal scale, and that the external church turned layered scriptures into literal history, handing followers only the lowest rung of understanding. His own answer is that spirit and matter were never split: matter is condensed spirit, and every listener already carries full sovereignty."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: David Whitehead returns to talk about the newest chapters of his documentary series, Cult of the Medics. We explore serpent symbolism, chemical castration, the dark goddess, economic syndicates, the connection between the Deep Church and the Great Reset.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension we go into overtime, covering the connection between the criminal underworld and corporate overworld, human origins and genetic modification, and David's research into big pharma's secretive use of venom-tech.
